changelog:
Initial release of lark-cli-devhub-calendar.

- Enables Feishu/Lark Calendar integrations via lark-cli/feishu-cli.
- Supports agendas, scheduling, freebusy checks, meeting room booking, RSVP, review blocks, and follow-up planning.
- Provides office-focused use cases such as bug bash and release scheduling, room finding, and linking calendar events to Dev Hub Releases.
- Includes example command-line usage and best practices for calendar vs. tasks management.
- Outlines suggested workflows for release and review automation.
